# CRC32 key collisions causing unintended lock contention

The repo_lock_key function uses zlib.crc32 to map arbitrary repository slugs into 32-bit keys. Different slugs can collide to the same 32-bit value, causing unrelated repositories to contend for the same advisory lock.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/db.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.db.repo_lock_key`
